scoring_justification: Hysteresis parameters are recomputed from raw magnetization curves and compared to paper-reported values; intermediate quantities are checked structurally with broad tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for hysteresis and structural rules for exchange/anisotropy
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Effects of exchange interactions on magnetic anisotropy... Fig.1, Fig.2, Fig.3 and accompanying text
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper-reported coercive fields, remanences, and described trends; tolerances added for toolchain spread.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All gold values directly trace to the paper's reported quantities.

outputs.description: Exchange coupling energies E_ex(d) for Co dimers on Cu(001) and Pt(001) at various separations and magnetic orderings. Scored by comparison to hidden paper-reported values with tolerance and a structural trend check for RKKY-like oscillation.

Per-atom magnetic anisotropy energies E_MA(d) for Co dimers on Cu(001) and Pt(001). Scored by comparison to hidden paper-reported values with tolerance and a structural trend check ensuring non-monotonous separation dependence and sensitivity to magnetic ordering.
Raw magnetization curves for representative Co dimers. The checker will recompute coercive fields and remanences from these curves and compare to hidden gold values derived from the paper.
Summary of coercive fields and remanences. The checker will recompute these values from step_02 and compare to the submitted summary and to hidden paper-derived gold.

output_contract.notes: The exchange coupling and anisotropy energies are intermediate scored artifacts that also serve as inputs for the KMC simulations. All separations and magnetic orderings used in the paper should be computed; the representative separations specifically targeted are those discussed in the paper's Figure 3.

steps.description: Verify structural properties of exchange coupling table: both substrates covered, sufficient separations, negative E_ex in 5-7 Å range for Cu, and consistent E_ex across ordering rows.
Check anisotropy energy table: for Cu FM moderate values with a compact outlier, AFM less variation than FM; Pt shows sign changes and large magnitudes.
Recompute coercive field and remanence from raw magnetization curves and compare to paper-reported values for representative dimers.
Verify that the submitted hysteresis summary matches recomputed values from the magnetization curves and aligns with the hidden gold.
